messages.text: Thanks John. Before we finalize the timeline: Noor, have you started the human evaluation of the 100 strings yet? I need those results to verify our baseline claims before the abstract is drafted.
she's on it actually. i think she's done like 40 already? noor, status check for prof?
I see. John, let's set a hard internal deadline: Noor to submit the raw eval data by Friday 25 Sep. Abstract due that same day? That seems tight.
tight but doable if we just lock the numbers then. i can draft the abstract skeleton tonight so it's just a fill-in-the-blanks job for the 25th.
Agreed. What about the full paper? I would prefer to see a complete draft by Monday 28 Sep so we have two days to discuss revisions before the Friday submission on Oct 2.
monday 28 works. i'll aim to have the related work section done by then too, that's my main bottleneck right now.
Good. Noor, please prioritize the evaluation over any new coding tasks until Friday. It is critical for the paper's validity.
totally fair. i'll handle the infra tasks (like that retry backoff logic) so she can focus on the data. noor, you good with that?
Excellent. I will review the intro changes and the figure placement once you send them. Keep me posted on Noor's progress.
will do. sending the updated draft in an hour or so. thanks again for pushing on the timeline, it helped clarify priorities.
